d: Deep navy blue hair is long and straight with blunt-cut bangs, framing a mature face of an adolescent with sharp, narrow pink eyes. A slender build is dressed in a long, black high-collared dress with a high side slit, featuring a white shoulder capelet, white buckles, and a white utility pouch strapped to the hip. Black gloves and black lace-up boots complete the attire, while a blue hardcover book is held in one hand.
